HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Prior employer review for the founders, February 7, 2011
Jane Doe. Last employer: Example Hospitality Group, left December 3, 2010. Her
agreement there has a 6-month nonsolicit of its staff and no invention clause.
Richard Roe. Last employer: Brightline Kitchen Systems, Inc., left January 14, 2011.
Roe's Brightline agreement assigns to Brightline any invention related to its
business made while he was employed there. Brightline sells kitchen equipment and
staff scheduling add-ons.
Roe wrote the first KitchenGrid scheduling prototype in November 2010, on his own
laptop and on weekends, while still employed by Brightline.
Open item: no release from Brightline has been requested or received. Richard will
ask a lawyer whether one is needed.
